notes.title: Alpha 2.2.0 Update Live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333998/3080d5d68e8d0519037a599914ca75a58e0e408f.png

 Alpha 2.2.0 Patch Notes 💖
- Updated countdown audio in story mode 
- Containerized and cleaned up block state management 
- Cleaned up board initialization and block instantiation 
- Resolved swap inconsistencies 
- Swaps now run more efficiently
- Removed block reset hack 
- Tera’s sprite updated
- Queen Polleen was named 
- 2x2 cursor can now partial swap if one block is immoveable (Era) 

Known Bugs 🐛
- Disconnected chains
- Polleen’s special freezes transforming garbage when special activated during a match
- Blocks getting stuck when falling 
- Era's cursor swap 1 and 2 buttons have been swapped
- Resolution has unexpected sizes whenever you go to the main menu... Can still be fixed with the in-game settings

Bonus 🍭
- AI was accidentally given sugar 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
